profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Bold Penguin
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 12+ years of experience building scalable, user-focused web applications, including more than 7 years working extensively with Ruby on Rails.

I specialize in full-stack product development, with deep experience in Ruby on Rails, ViewComponent, Hotwire (Turbo and Stimulus), JavaScript, and modern frontend architecture. I enjoy taking complex requirements and turning them into maintainable, intuitive solutions that make a real difference for users.

Throughout my career, I’ve helped architect configurable platforms, modernize large applications, and build reusable component systems that improve consistency and developer efficiency. I value clean, thoughtful code, strong collaboration, and finding practical solutions that help both users and engineering teams succeed.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Co-architected and developed a configurable multi-source insights platform built with Ruby on Rails,
ViewComponent, and Hotwire, enabling dynamic source configuration and role-based data visibility.

Helped lead a major redesign of the Group Engagement application, partnering with Product and Design
to deliver a more intuitive user experience while modernizing the application's frontend architecture.

Collaborated on the architecture and implementation of a reusable ViewComponent library that became
the foundation of a major product redesign, establishing standardized Turbo Frame and Turbo Stream
patterns that reduced duplicate code, accelerated feature delivery, and created a consistent UI across
multiple product areas.

Led the implementation of major full-stack product initiatives including redesigned profile management,
connections, and messaging experiences, partnering closely with Product and Design from planning
through release.

Designed and implemented asynchronous AI workflows that generated structured insight summaries from
customer observation data using large language models.

Helped architect platform-wide localization using Smartling, enabling the application to support multiple
languages and international customers.

Built and maintained internal administration tools that enabled client success teams to configure
customer-facing experiences without engineering involvement.

Diagnosed and resolved complex Hotwire, Turbo, and Stimulus race conditions, improving application
reliability, performance, and maintainability.

Collaborated closely with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering throughout Agile planning, implementation, testing, and deployment to deliver high-quality customer-facing features.

Served a one-year rotation as Team Lead for a Scrum team of three engineers before returning to a full-time individual contributor role to focus on hands-on engineering.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: JavaScript · Markup Languages · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Team Lead - Front End Development
positions.description:
Lead/Manage the Front End Development Team. This covers all programming after data is passed from our Back End Team. Through a MVC structure using smarty, develop web pages using semantic HTML/HTML5, Smarty, CSS3, SASS, GULP,  Bootstrap, JavaScript, JQuery (all work done with responsive design in mind). Also worked many Full Stack Projects involving PHP development. 
Work with business to estimate and manage all work coming in to Team. This includes working closely with the Product Manager of Web and Web Architect to fully understand project work that will be developed.
Divide up and estimate all work between team and set necessary due dates for prompt delivery of work to be tested and installed. 
Through GIT version control (both in the terminal and GITLAB), manage all merge request and branching for each sprint. 
Passionate about team members working together and having a strong desire to build each other up and share knowledge.
positions.insights: Skills: Markup Languages · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies

positions.title: Front End Web Developer II
positions.description:
Worked as a liaison between the IT department and the Digital Marketing department.
Main developer of all MJML/HTML email work. This included becoming proficient in Adobe
Campaign and creating well detailed documentation.
Developed a standard for all modules and code blocks used in each email send for a faster and
more proficient deliverable.
Worked a great deal in an Oracle CMS and developed many landing pages using HTML, CSS3,
SASS (BEM naming), and JQuery in a JSP templating structure.
Created detailed documentation regarding the development lifecycle.
positions.insights: Skills: Markup Languages · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies

positions.title: Front End Web Developer
positions.description:
December 2014 - September 2017
Front End Developer within a Bootstrap framework. Through a MVC structure using smarty, designed and developed web pages using HTML/HTML5, Smarty, CSS3, SASS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, JQuery (all work done with responsive design in mind). Also worked many Full Stack Projects involving PHP development.  
Worked with other developers on projects using a continuous integration model (CICD)(work pushed, pulled, committed and deployed through GIT). Worked in 6 week sprints (2 of those weeks for QA), using the PHPStorm IDE.
Tested front-end code in multiple browsers to ensure cross-browser compatibility. This also involved writing ‘how to’ documentation for each project worked. 
Developed a User Interface for a Messaging system. 
Main lead on the development of biometric and money pages for participants desiring to see their PHI information (all following 508 compliance). 
Product owner of our Internal Admin Website. Worked many Full Stack projects as the owner of this system, from designing wireframes (MOQUPS Software) to the completion of projects. 
Participated in many other projects in all stages of the product life cycle.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Markup Languages · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies

positions.title: Web Implentation Specialist
positions.description:
· Through our internal Modularization process, built and audited each clients web portal. This amounted to around 300 sites.
· During much of this time, trained to be a web develop. Many small tasks accomplished.

positions.title: Implementation Specialist
positions.description:
· Processed and audited plan data and result letters for clients looking for data inconsistencies
· Built, organized and finalized plans before they go live to ensure they are executed accurately.
· Attended meetings and calls internally, with clients, and with vendors to coordinate, clarify and implement the
program

positions.title: Director and Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
Music Leader for Sunday Services. This has included building teams and raising up leaders. 
Schedule multiple teams (80+ people) using a web based software database management system. 
Prepared and Designed four weekly orders of service. This involved coordinating with all department leads for the direction of each service. 
Helped organize recording of Live Worship Album. This involved song writing, arranging, organized rehearsals, and direct contact with producer. 
Responsible for all music selection for Church Services. 
Curriculum preparation for workshops within the creative arts department.
Training and Developing leaders in many areas of the department.
Counseling and Pastoring of department members as needed.
